text: When I slide into a robot it should be launched into the air, spin over and crash on its back, then slowly clamber up. Right now the robots just bump and push through each other.

- Any slide at 6 m/s or faster into an upright opponent now floors it (cartwheel, thrown 40 degrees off the line), with or without the ball. This replaces the contract's "into non-carrier: react 0.7". It applies to rival and mate slides too.
- The slider that floors a non-carrier still lies 40 frames (`contact.slider_lie`). The slider that floors the carrier is still up after 18.
- The captain's slide (robot 0) now also hits and floors his own mates. Other robots' slides still ignore their mates. "His" here refers to robot 0, the captain.
- A slide into a robot still inside its 60-frame get-up guard now makes it stumble, and a carrier loses the ball and the slider stumbles too. Before, the slide passed through it.
- Slide into slide (both rebound), slide under hop (passes beneath) and a miss are unchanged.
- `contact.launch_height` is new: 1.8 m (was 1.2 in script).
- `contact.fly_f` is new: 28 frames (was 20 in script). The full turn takes this long.
- `contact.bounce_height` is new: 0.35 m (was 0.25). `contact.bounce_f` is new: 8 frames (was 6).
- `getup.min` went from 60 to 75, `getup.max` from 90 to 105, and `getup.clamber` from 30 to 45.
- `feel.land_f` is removed; landing sound and dust now fire at `contact.fly_f`, with an added metal clang.
- `look.tip_from` is new (0.55): the figure tips from upright to flat on its back over the rest of the flight, instead of snapping flat on landing.
- `tumble_cartwheel` keys are still authored as frames 0–20 and 20–26, and are stretched over `fly_f` and `bounce_f`.
- A short fall's clamber is now compressed to `down_total - fly_f - bounce_f`, at most `clamber`. The new `sim.clamber_frames(robot)` returns it.
- The spring-up window (frames 28–36, up at 48) is unchanged and now starts as the robot lands.
- Three `params` were added to `pack.json`: launch height, flight frames and clamber frames.
